question: The 2018 edition of Commonwealth Games was hosted by:
solution:
The correct answer is **__Australia.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Commonwealth Games 2018 was held on the Gold Coast, Australia.**
 
• Officially known as** 'XXI Commonwealth Games.**
 
• **Mascot: Borobi.**
 
• **Motto: Share the Dream.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **71 Commonwealth Games Associations** participated in this event.
 
• Open ceremony was inaugurated by** Charles, Prince of Wales**.
 
• Australia topped the medal table for the fourth time in the commonwealth games with **80 Gold medals.**
 
• **India made its 18th appearance at the Commonwealth Games.**
 
• India finished third for the tournament with** 26 Golds.**
 
• **First medal for India in Commonwealth Games 2018: Gururaja Poojary (Silver).**
 
• **First Gold medal for India in Commonwealth Games 2018: Mirabai Chanu.**
 
• **PV Sindhu was named flag-bearer of India for the opening ceremony in Gold Coast.**
 
• **Mary Kom carries India's flag at the closing ceremony in Gold Coast.**
 
• **The 2022 Commonwealth Games is scheduled to be held in Birmingham, England.**
